key_insight: ORSMT uses exact SMT checks to detect and repair semantic mismatches between optimization models and solver code, beyond agreement on objective values.
engineering_relevance: It helps engineers validate LLM-generated optimization pipelines by checking feasible regions and objectives while accounting for auxiliary variables.
method: Align observable decisions through a typed semantic interface and project away auxiliary variables.
Prove or refute feasible-region and objective relations, localizing failures to rows or domains.
Reconstruct artifacts and adopt repair candidates only after required relation checks pass.
evidence_signal: Across 3,034 problems and six generator sizes, protected selection increased aggregate model-code matching from 43.2% to 88.2%, while correct-and-matched outputs rose from 25.2% to 40.2%.
watch_item: Model-code agreement does not guarantee source correctness: both artifacts can omit the same requirement, making source-level validation essential.
paper_title: ORSMT: Unleashing the Potential of Satisfiability Modulo Theories for Semantic Verification and Repair in LLM-Based Optimization
